label: Kidney development: nephric duct and ureteric bud
reason: Nearly all members cover nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric development and how it is regulated.

label: Lipoprotein and intestinal/biliary sterol transport
reason: HDL/LDL remodelling, chylomicron assembly and ABC transporter sterol/bile efflux all serve lipid transport homeostasis.

label: Platelet activation GPCR and integrin signalling
reason: PAR, P2Y, TP and prostacyclin receptors, G12/13-Rho, Rap1 and integrin signalling are all platelet activation pathways.

label: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neurons
reason: Neural tube patterning, floor plate and the specification of spinal motor neurons and interneurons form one developmental programme.

label: Transcriptional control of hepatic glucose/lipid metabolism
reason: ChREBP, SREBP, LXR, PPARA, PGC1a and clock factors all regulate metabolic gene expression in response to nutrients.

label: Membrane potential and Na+/K+ gradients
reason: K+ channels, Na/K-ATPase (glycoside response), ion homeostasis and resting potential all set excitability.

label: Microglial TREM2/DAP12 phagocytosis and activation
reason: Apoptotic cell clearance, microglial activation and amyloid-beta handling follow the TREM2-DAP12 microglial axis.

label: Xenobiotic and phytochemical biotransformation
reason: CYP, FMO, sulfonation, methylation and acetylation of drugs, toxins and plant compounds are all xenobiotic metabolism.

label: Erythrocyte gas, ammonium and lactate transport
reason: Oxygen/CO2 exchange, Rh-glycoprotein ammonium/CO2 channels and MCT1/basigin lactate transport are linked as red cell membrane solute and gas transport.

label: Retroviral life cycle and host silencing
reason: HIV replication and integration steps are joined by host restriction and silencing of integrated viral DNA and retroelements (APOBEC3G, HUSH, KRAB-ZFP).

label: Cellular senescence via p53/p16/ARF
reason: Oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, p53/p21, CDKN2A/Polycomb, SAHF and SASP make up one senescence programme.

label: Mitochondrial genome replication and expression
reason: mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, ribosome assembly and translation; the Pol II elongation term is a lone outlier.

label: MHC antigen processing and presentation
reason: MHC I/II loading, cross-presentation, the proteasome and viral (Nef/Vpu) evasion of presentation all centre on antigen presentation.

label: GABA and glutamate synthesis and transport
reason: Synthesis, vesicular loading, reuptake and degradation of the amino-acid neurotransmitters GABA and glutamate/aspartate.

label: NGF/TrkA and p75NTR signalling
reason: All members are NGF signalling through TrkA and p75NTR to ERK5, PI3K, NF-kB, CREB and death pathways.

label: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis
reason: BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK, cytochrome c/SMAC release and apoptosome caspase activation.

label: Synaptic neurotransmitter handling and release
reason: GABA/glutamate transport and metabolism joined with cholinergic NMJ transmission and clostridial toxin blockade of SNAREs, linked by the synaptic transmitter cycle; one bile acid term is an outlier.

label: Platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation
reason: VWF/GPIb and GPVI adhesion, GPCR activation signalling, degranulation and coagulation are all platelet haemostasis.

label: Proteasomal degradation and protein quality control
reason: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation, degron pathways and ribosome-associated quality control; the few stress granule terms fall within proteostasis.

label: Misfolded protein aggregate clearance
reason: Aggresome assembly, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, microautophagy and the misfolded protein response all handle protein aggregates.

label: CYP450 eicosanoid and fatty acid oxidation
reason: Omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase P450 pathways, HETE/EET/hepoxilin synthesis and omega-oxidation are one oxidative lipid metabolism theme.

label: RUNX1 regulation and megakaryocyte/erythroid differentiation
reason: RUNX-family target programmes join megakaryocyte/erythroid lineage terms through RUNX1's specific role in megakaryopoiesis.

label: Leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism and signalling
reason: Leukotriene synthesis, catabolism, transport and receptors, plus lipoxins, form the 5-lipoxygenase eicosanoid axis.

label: NK/T cell regulation via MHC immunoreceptors
reason: NK receptor (KIR) control, T cell tolerance/costimulation and DC differentiation are linked by MHC-ligand immunoregulatory receptor interactions.

label: NK and T cell activation and tolerance
reason: NK cytotoxicity, T cell activation and tolerance, Treg/Th differentiation and DC maturation are linked by lymphocyte immunoreceptor regulation.

label: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, transport, degradation
reason: Dopamine, norepinephrine and serotonin synthesis, SLC6 reuptake and MAO/COMT degradation; histamine receptors are a minor outlier.

label: Cell cycle G1/S and G2/M control
reason: CDK4/6-RB-E2F, DREAM, cyclin degradation, G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry events are all cell cycle regulation.

label: Gut-brain hormonal control of feeding and GI
reason: Appetite and feeding behaviour, GI motility and secretion, and nutrient/peptide hormone GPCRs (glucagon, amylin, ghrelin, leptin, FFAR) are linked by the enteroendocrine gut-brain axis.

label: Chemokine-driven leukocyte chemotaxis
reason: Chemokines and their receptors (CCR7, CXCR4) directing DC, T and NK cell migration and homing.

label: Endosomal TLR TRIF/MyD88 signalling
reason: TLR3-TRIF and TLR7/8/9 IRAK/TRAF6 signalling to IKK, TAK1 and IRF3/7, including HSE deficiencies.

label: Gamma-secretase intramembrane proteolysis signalling
reason: Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR signalling are linked by regulated intramembrane proteolysis that releases nuclear-signalling intracellular domains.

label: Notch receptor signalling
reason: Notch1-4 processing, intracellular domain transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants; the Th2 and pancreatic terms are Notch-driven contexts.

label: Retroviral restriction and AID/APOBEC immune diversification
reason: HIV life cycle and restriction join somatic hypermutation, class switching and RNA editing through AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination.

label: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron development
reason: Motor neuron specification, hindbrain/brainstem development and cranial nerves, with brainstem-controlled behaviours such as suckling and breathing.

label: Bone and tooth mineralization
reason: Bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization with phosphate regulation (FGF23-Klotho, PTH, FAM20C phosphorylation).

label: RTK-RAS-MAPK/PI3K signalling and oncogenic mutants
reason: FGFR, KIT, PDGFR, ERBB, ALK and FLT3 signalling through RAS/RAF/MAPK and PI3K, plus oncogenic and drug-resistant mutants.

label: p75NTR signalling and axon regeneration
reason: p75NTR death and survival signalling, ceramide and RHOA axonal growth inhibition, and neuron projection regeneration.

label: Cerebellar development and motor coordination
reason: Cerebellar layer formation, Bergmann glia and granule precursors, together with motor learning, proprioception and locomotor behaviour.

label: Golgi organization and COPI trafficking
reason: COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport, and Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly.

label: TLR3-TRIF signalling and necroptosis
reason: TLR3/TRIF IRF3 signalling and HSE deficiencies are linked to RIPK1/RIPK3/ZBP1 necroptosis through RHIM-domain TRIF-RIPK interactions.
